summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 720KB payload
details: The npm package's declared `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases` at a hardcoded version and then uses that freshly-downloaded binary to execute the bundled `math_init.js`, a 727,680-byte single-line obfuscator.io-style file (rotated string-array `n7gIxM`, shuffle helper `WV8StW`, base64-like decoder `hc1jfK9`, `_0x`-style identifiers, no exports). A Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin has no functional need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to invoke a large obfuscated sibling script with it. Executing bundled code via a non-Node runtime pulled in at install specifically bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanning of the install path, and running obfuscated code as part of `npm install` grants arbitrary code execution on any machine that installs the package. The `@bun @bun-cjs` banner in `math_init.js` confirms the payload is bound to the fetched Bun binary rather than to the host Node runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
